gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.content: First time? Go to the "Register" tab to create a username. If you are a returning user, select your username from the "Sign In" tab to continue your journey.

quizSetup.title: Setting Up a Quiz
quizSetup.content: On the main screen, customize your quiz. Select an academic level, choose one or more subjects, set the quiz length, and configure other options like question format and timer.

playing.title: Playing the Quiz
playing.content: Answer questions by clicking the options or typing your answer. If enabled, the timer will count down. You can use voice commands like "Alpha", "Bravo" for multiple choice, or say the answer for typed questions. Say "Next" to move to the next question.

music.title: Background Music
music.content: Use the music player on the main screen to play/pause, skip tracks, and toggle repeat modes (repeat all vs. repeat single). You can upload your own music from the pop-up after logging in, or by going to Settings > Load Background Music.

settings.title: Application Settings
settings.content: Click the gear icon in the header to open settings. Here you can change the theme color, manage your music library, adjust volume, and log out.

musicAdmin.title: Permanent Music Storage
musicAdmin.noFiles: No music files found in the database.
musicAdmin.confirmRemove: Are you sure you want to permanently remove "{{trackName}}"?
musicAdmin.footer: These files are stored permanently in the browser's IndexedDB. Changes here will affect the default playlist for all users of this instance.

adminDashboard.title: Admin Panel
adminDashboard.creatorInfoContent: For user privacy and technical reasons within a sandboxed browser environment, user IP addresses are not and cannot be tracked by this application.
adminDashboard.assistantDescription: Use AI to modify this application. Describe the changes you want in plain English, and the assistant will apply them and reload the app.
adminDashboard.assistantPromptLabel: Describe the changes you want to make
adminDashboard.assistantPromptPlaceholder: e.g., Change the primary theme color to purple and add 'orange' as an option. Add a new 'Fun Facts' subject category.
